usedFor: Harvest tracks time and projects, and each “New Project” can add a to-do in Todoist.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Harvest, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: A new Harvest project turns into a Todoist task, so the setup work is not forgotten.

watchOut: “New Project” in Harvest is polling, so “Create Task” in Todoist runs after a scheduled check.
